messages.content: Hey, it's your weekly check-in from Northline Care. Hope the week's been okay out there. Were you able to get a blood pressure reading today?
I tried this morning but the dang cuff keeps flashing ERR. I don't know what that means, never seen it do that before.

That's a real hassle, I'm sorry. I have to be straight with you though — device troubleshooting isn't something I'm set up to help with through this line. You'd want to contact the cuff manufacturer or wherever you got it. Did you manage to get any readings earlier in the week before it started acting up?
Yeah I got one Thursday evening. 151 over 94.
Got it, I'll log that — 151/94 on Thursday. How about your blood pressure medication this week, were you able to take it most days?
Mostly yeah. I think I missed it Tuesday, just slipped my mind.
Okay, I've noted the missed dose on Tuesday. I'll get your next check-in set for the same time next week. Take care of yourself, and hopefully that cuff cooperates soon.

theme: blood pressure cuff shows ERR, device support
